desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT community is focused on a major Ukrainian drone raid across Russia tonight, with strikes hitting oil infrastructure and triggering air-defense alerts near Moscow and Crimea. The single most important development is the scale of the attack, with reports of record drone numbers and multiple facilities damaged.

## MAIN THREADS
### Large-Scale Ukrainian Drone Raid
- [@Archer83Able](https://x.com/Archer83Able/status/2122436475929190659) reports a massive drone raid, with Russian sources calling it potentially record-breaking; air defenses active near Kerch/Crimean Bridge, all major Moscow airports closed, and Sobyanin claiming 150+ UAVs intercepted.
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2122431923297587580) and [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2122429275391275340) confirm Moscow airports suspended and renewed air-defense activity near the Crimean Bridge, including FPV carrier drones.
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2122444635171602863) details damage to Nizhnekamskneftekhim petrochemical plant and TAIF-NK refinery in Nizhnekamsk, with ethylene unit on fire and production halted.

### Oil Infrastructure Strikes
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2122430390379872459) shares satellite imagery showing two oil depots burning in Azov, Rostov region, after overnight strikes on Yug Impex and Flash Energy facilities.

### Other Developments
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2122439487624269910) notes California Governor Newsom’s visit to Lviv and announcement of aid including a 50-bed field hospital and generators.
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2122432254601248906) reports 72 killed in Komyshuvas rescue operation after Russian attack.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@Archer83Able](https://x.com/Archer83Able/status/2122445018648465675) on historical YF-12A interceptor (unconfirmed relevance to current events).
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2122432341989642720) on Russian servicemen notified of suspicion for Bucha crimes (unconfirmed).
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2122432254601248906) on completed Komyshuvas search-and-rescue (unconfirmed casualty breakdown).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are tracking whether the drone wave continues overnight and any confirmed hits on additional Russian energy sites. Expect updates on Moscow airport reopenings and Russian air-defense claims.
